description: May 13 birthday meaning: Taurus decan 3, birthday number 4, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a May 13 birthday falls in Taurus, in the third decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Saturn as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 4. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Taurus is fixed and earth.

sections.heading: May 13 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Thirteen reduces to 4, the number of foundations, and May 13th sets it in Taurus's most Saturnine stretch. With the Sun twenty-two degrees along, the emphasis falls on durability: projects that outlast fashions, routines that actually hold. Interpretive astrology describes a temperament that earns trust through consistency, though it may need reminding that rest is part of any sound structure.

On May 13 the Sun usually sits at about 22° Taurus, in the third decan, where Saturn is the sub-ruler alongside Venus. The closing decan of Taurus answers to Saturn, ruler of Capricorn, and this lends the sign's earthiness a long-range, structural quality. Instead of only enjoying what is solid, mid-May natives are often drawn to building it: savings, institutions, skills that compound over decades. Astrologers tend to call them serious, reliable and quietly ambitious, with a dry humour that surfaces once trust is established. Saturn can also bring a heavier sense of duty and a habit of postponing pleasure until some imagined finish line. Remembering that Taurus is a Venus sign first can help, because rest and beauty belong inside the structure too.

sections.heading: May 13 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 13th, your birthday compound is 13, reducing as 1 + 3 = 4. Some numerologists treat 13 as a karmic debt number, read not as bad luck but as a call to patient, consistent effort. The 1 adds initiative and the 3 adds imagination, and both feed into the 4's practical discipline. Those born on this day are frequently described as hard workers with an inventive streak, able to rebuild something better after it has fallen apart. The day number is secondary, yet in the 13 it often surfaces as a stubborn, constructive determination.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one May 13 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on May 13: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: May brings late spring in the northern hemisphere, a season of blossom and long evenings, and late autumn to the southern. Taurus holds the first three weeks, with Gemini arriving around May 20 or 21. In numerology May is month 5, the number of freedom, curiosity and change, which tends to give these birthdays a restless, experimental streak beneath the calm Taurean surface. May 13 is the 133rd day of the year (134th in a leap year). By May 21, 8 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Gemini.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by May 13, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on May 13 include Pius IX (1792), Alphonse Daudet (1840) and Maria Theresa of Austria (1717).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is May 13?
faq.answer: May 13 is Taurus in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Taurus, which tradition links with Saturn.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on May 13?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On May 13 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 11 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 4 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 4 for everyone born on the 13th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on May 13?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a May 13 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on May 13?
faq.answer: May 13 is also the birthday of Pius IX (1792), Alphonse Daudet (1840) and Maria Theresa of Austria (1717). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
